head: d710a07f5a42ad4a20ed47365f3b472a37e54088
claim: A host opens the allow or deny choice a phone sealed for a notification button, through the relay, and refuses a choice replayed onto another button or notification

steps.start: Built workspace packages (push, relay, pair, seal dist) with a loopback relay not yet running; no phone, host or device paired; fake Expo push fetch empty.
steps: Started a loopback relay and admitted a host named Kitchen computer, then the host connected to the relay.
Paired a phone named Umer phone to the host through the relay and subscribed an iOS push token.
Host sent notice perm-7 with the choices Allow and Deny and actions allow and deny, with the content sealed to the phone's key.
Phone opened the notice from the push payload and read the question and its two choices.
Phone pressed Allow on perm-7, sealing the Allow choice for that notification and button, and posted the press to the relay.
Host received the press and opened it as a choice and as typed text; it read the choice as allow.
Host sent notice perm-8 with the same choices.
Phone sealed an Allow choice and pressed it on the Deny button of perm-8; the relay forwarded it and the host refused it.
Host sent notice perm-9 with the same choices.
Phone replayed the Allow seal made for perm-7 onto the Allow button of perm-9; the host refused it.
Stopped the host client, relay and HTTP server.
steps.result: The Allow press on perm-7 answered 200 with {"ok":true,"value":{"answered":"perm-7"}} and the host recorded choice allow (openAnswer null). The Allow seal pressed on Deny (perm-8) and the perm-7 Allow seal replayed onto perm-9 each returned 502 {"error":"not an answer from this phone"}. Recorded answers: ["choice:allow"].
